```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	eval = TRUE,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(ggplot2)
library(haven)
library(readxl)
library(kableExtra)
library(modelsummary)
```

# Load Data
```{r}
# Load Opportunity Atlas data
tract_outcomes <- read_dta("../data/raw/tract_outcomes.dta")
```

# Filter Atlas Dataset
```{r}
# Multi-City Dataset
city_tracts <- tract_outcomes %>%
  
  # Filter to NYC, LA, Chicago, Houston, Atlanta, and Boston
  mutate(city = case_when(
    state == 36 & county %in% c(5, 47, 61, 81, 85) ~ "New York City",
    state == 6  & county == 37 ~ "Los Angeles",
    state == 17 & county == 31 ~ "Chicago",
    state == 48 & county == 201 ~ "Houston",
    state == 13 & county %in% c(89, 121, 135) ~ "Atlanta",
    state == 25 & county == 25 ~ "Boston",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(city)) %>%
  
  # Select vars
  select(
    city, state, county, tract,
    
    # Pooled mobility at p25 parental income (main outcome)
    kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, 

    # By race at p25
    kfr_white_pooled_p25,
    kfr_black_pooled_p25,
    kfr_hisp_pooled_p25,
    kfr_asian_pooled_p25,
    
    # Unconditional means by race
    kfr_pooled_pooled_mean,
    kfr_white_pooled_mean,
    kfr_black_pooled_mean,
    kfr_hisp_pooled_mean,
    kfr_asian_pooled_mean,

    # Secondary outcomes
    kfr_pooled_pooled_p1,
    kfr_top20_pooled_pooled_p25,
    jail_pooled_pooled_p25,
    teenbrth_pooled_female_p25,
    two_par_pooled_pooled_p25,
    lpov_nbh_pooled_pooled_p25) %>%
  
  # Create outcome gap vars (compare to white)
  mutate(
    gap_black = kfr_white_pooled_p25 - kfr_black_pooled_p25,
    gap_hispanic = kfr_white_pooled_p25 - kfr_hisp_pooled_p25,
    gap_asian = kfr_white_pooled_p25 - kfr_asian_pooled_p25) %>%
  
  # Add borough label from county code
  mutate(borough = case_when(
    county == 5  ~ "Bronx",
    county == 47 ~ "Brooklyn",
    county == 61 ~ "Manhattan",
    county == 81 ~ "Queens",
    county == 85 ~ "Staten Island"))

# NYC-Only Dataset
nyc_tracts <- city_tracts %>%
  filter(city == "New York City")
saveRDS(nyc_tracts, "../output/nyc_tracts.rds")
```

\newpage

# Cross-City Summary
```{r}
# Summary statistics table by city
city_summary <- city_tracts %>%
  group_by(city) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mobility = mean(kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_mobility = median(kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_mobility = sd(kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_top20  = mean(kfr_top20_pooled_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mob_white = mean(kfr_white_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mob_black = mean(kfr_black_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mob_hispanic = mean(kfr_hisp_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mob_asian = mean(kfr_asian_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gap_black = mean(gap_black, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gap_hispanic = mean(gap_hispanic, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gap_asian = mean(gap_asian, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_tracts = n(),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_mobility))
saveRDS(city_summary, "../output/city_summary.rds")

# Render summary statistics table by city
city_summary_table <- city_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_mobility)) %>%
  select(city, n_tracts, mean_mobility, sd_mobility,
         mean_mob_white, mean_mob_black, mean_mob_hispanic, mean_mob_asian,
         mean_gap_black, mean_gap_hispanic, mean_gap_asian) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("City", "# Tracts", "Mean", "SD",
                  "White", "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian",
                  "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian"),
    caption = "Intergenerational Mobility by City (Low-Income Childr Born 1978–1983)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 4,
                     "Mobility by Race" = 4,
                     "Gap Relative to White" = 3))
city_summary_table


# Figure 1: Mean mobility by city
city_mean_mobility_barplot <- ggplot(city_summary, aes(x = reorder(city, mean_mobility), y = mean_mobility)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "lightblue", color = "skyblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(
    ymin = mean_mobility - sd_mobility,
    ymax = mean_mobility + sd_mobility),
    width = 0.3, color = "grey40") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Intergenerational Mobility by City",
    subtitle = "Low-Income Children Born 1978-1983",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Income Rank",
    caption  = "Error bars = ±1 SD across tracts. Source: Opportunity Atlas") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("../output/city_mean_mobility_barplot.png", plot = city_mean_mobility_barplot)
city_mean_mobility_barplot

# Figure 2: Distribution of tract-level mobility by city
city_mobility_dist <- ggplot(city_tracts, aes(x = kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, fill = city)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tract-Level Mobility Across Cities",
    subtitle = "Low-Income Children Born 1978-1983",
    x = "Mean Income Rank",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "City",
    caption = "Source: Opportunity Atlas") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("../output/city_mobility_dist.png", plot = city_mobility_dist)
city_mobility_dist
```

# Within NYC Borough Variation
```{r}
# Borough summary statistics
borough_summary <- nyc_tracts %>%
  group_by(borough) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mobility = mean(kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_mobility = median(kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_mobility = sd(kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_top20 = mean(kfr_top20_pooled_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_jail = mean(jail_pooled_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_teen_birth = mean(teenbrth_pooled_female_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_two_parent = mean(two_par_pooled_pooled_p25,  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_tracts = n(),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_mobility))

# Render borough summary statistics
borough_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_mobility)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Borough", "Mean", "Median", "SD",
                  "Prob. Top 20%", "Incarceration", "Teen Birth", "Two-Parent", "# Tracts"),
    caption = "Intergenerational Mobility by NYC Borough (Low-Income Children Born 1978–1983)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                     "Mobility" = 3,
                     "Secondary Outcomes" = 4,
                     " " = 1))
borough_summary
saveRDS(borough_summary, "../output/borough_summary.rds")

# Figure 3: Distribution of mobility across tracts by borough
nyc_mobility_dist_density <- ggplot(nyc_tracts, aes(x = kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, fill = borough)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Intergenerational Mobility Across NYC Tracts by Borough",
    subtitle = "Low-Income Children Born 1978-1983",
    x = "Mean Income Rank",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Borough",
    caption = "Source: Opportunity Atlas") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("../output/nyc_mobility_dist_density.png", plot = nyc_mobility_dist_density)
nyc_mobility_dist_density

# Figure 4: Violin Plot of tract-level mobility by borough
nyc_mobility_dist_violin <- ggplot(nyc_tracts, aes(x = reorder(borough, kfr_pooled_pooled_p25, FUN = median, na.rm = TRUE),
                       y = kfr_pooled_pooled_p25,
                       fill = borough)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +

    title = "Tract-Level Mobility Distribution by NYC Borough",
    subtitle = "Low-Income Children Born 1978-1983",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Income Rank",

ggsave("../output/nyc_mobility_dist_violin.png", plot = nyc_mobility_dist_violin)
nyc_mobility_dist_violin
```

# Racial Mobility Gaps
```{r}
# Borough-level racial gap summary
gap_summary <- nyc_tracts %>%
  group_by(borough) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mob_white = mean(kfr_white_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mob_black = mean(kfr_black_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mob_hispanic = mean(kfr_hisp_pooled_p25,  na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mob_asian = mean(kfr_asian_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gap_black = mean(gap_black, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gap_hispanic = mean(gap_hispanic, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gap_asian = mean(gap_asian, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")
saveRDS(gap_summary, "../output/gap_summary.rds")

# Render borough-level racial gap summary table
gap_summary_table <- gap_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_gap_black)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Borough",
                  "White", "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian",
                  "Black", "Hispanic", "Asian"),
    caption = "Racial Mobility Gaps by NYC Borough (Gap = White Minus Other Group)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                     "Mean Mobility by Race" = 4,
                     "Gap Relative to White" = 3))
gap_summary_table

# Figure 5: Racial mobility by borough
mobility_long <- nyc_tracts %>%
  group_by(borough) %>%
  summarise(
    White = mean(kfr_white_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Black = mean(kfr_black_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hispanic = mean(kfr_hisp_pooled_p25,na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian = mean(kfr_asian_pooled_p25, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(White, Black, Hispanic, Asian),
               names_to = "race", values_to = "mobility")

nyc_mobility_by_race <- ggplot(mobility_long, aes(x = borough, y = mobility, fill = race)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Intergenerational Mobility by Race and Borough",
    subtitle = "Low-Income Children Born 1978-1983",
    x = "Borough",
    y = "Mean Income Rank",
    fill = "Race",
    caption = "Source: Opportunity Atlas") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))
ggsave("../output/nyc_mobility_by_race.png", plot = nyc_mobility_by_race)
nyc_mobility_by_race

# Figure 6: Racial gap relative to white by borough
gap_long <- nyc_tracts %>%
  group_by(borough) %>%
  summarise(
    Black = mean(gap_black, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hispanic = mean(gap_hispanic, na.rm = TRUE),
    Asian = mean(gap_asian, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Black, Hispanic, Asian),
               names_to = "race", values_to = "gap")

nyc_gap_barplot <- ggplot(gap_long, aes(x = borough, y = gap, fill = race)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "Racial Mobility Gap Relative to White Children, by Borough",
    x = "Borough",
    y = "Mobility Gap",
    fill = "Race",
    caption  = "Source: Opportunity Atlas") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))
nyc_gap_barplot
ggsave("../output/nyc_gap_barplot.png", plot = nyc_gap_barplot)

# Figure 7: Tract-level gap distributions by borough
nyc_gap_dist <- nyc_tracts %>%
  select(borough, gap_black, gap_hispanic, gap_asian) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("gap_"),
               names_to = "race", values_to = "gap") %>%
  mutate(race = recode(race,
    "gap_black" = "Black",
    "gap_hispanic" = "Hispanic",
    "gap_asian" = "Asian")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gap, fill = race)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  facet_wrap(~borough) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Racial Mobility Gaps Across NYC Tracts",
    x = "Mobility Gap",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Race",
    caption  = "Source: Opportunity Atlas") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("../output/nyc_gap_dist.png", plot = nyc_gap_dist)
nyc_gap_dist


```

# Regression 

```{r}
# Does borough predict pooled mobility?
model1 <- lm(kfr_pooled_pooled_p25 ~ borough, data = nyc_tracts)
saveRDS(model1, "../output/model1.rds")

# Does borough predict Black-white gap?
model2 <- lm(gap_black ~ borough, data = nyc_tracts)
saveRDS(model2, "../output/model2.rds")

# Does borough predict Hispanic-white gap?
model3 <- lm(gap_hispanic ~ borough, data = nyc_tracts)
saveRDS(model3, "../output/model3.rds")

# Display regression table
modelsummary(
  list("Pooled Mobility" = model1,
       "Black-White Gap" = model2,
       "Hispanic-White Gap" = model3),
  stars = TRUE,
  coef_rename = c(
    "boroughBrooklyn" = "Brooklyn",
    "boroughManhattan" = "Manhattan",
    "boroughQueens"  = "Queens",
    "boroughStaten Island" = "Staten Island"),
  gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared"),
  title = "OLS Regressions: Borough Predictors of Mobility and Racial Gaps",
  notes = "Reference category: Bronx. Standard errors in parentheses.")

```
